title: Rosenbrock inside a unit disk
description: Solves the original nonlinear disk-constrained objective and reports primal feasibility, dual feasibility, stationarity and complementarity.

reproduction.method: Feasible logarithmic-barrier continuation with Newton solves
reproduction.description: Solves the original nonlinear disk-constrained objective and reports primal feasibility, dual feasibility, stationarity and complementarity.
differences: Independent TypeScript conceptual reproduction; not execution or validation of the original MATLAB/Octave program.
Explicit log-barrier Newton replaces fmincon and its three derivative-configuration comparisons.
The infeasible original start is moved radially to radius 0.8 before barrier continuation; all displayed iterates are feasible.
